description.message: Your own list of which email address or username you gave to which website. Kept on this device only.

ar_lead.message: Which email address or username you gave to which website. If spam arrives on one address, you know who passed it on.

ar_disp_summary.message: Make a disposable address (free, no sign-up)

ar_disp_intro.message: Klin asks the free service **mail.tm** for a new random address. Write the site in the form above first, then press the button. You read what arrives right here.

ar_disp1.message: Good for sign-ups, trials and anything you can afford to lose.

ar_disp2.message: **mail.tm can read every message sent to it** and may delete the address at any time. Never use it for your bank, your main accounts or password recovery.

ar_disp3.message: Pressing the button contacts api.mail.tm with your IP address. Klin asks your permission first.

ar_plus_summary.message: Make a plus address from my own email

ar_plus_note.message: Gives **me+site@example.org**. It works only with some providers, and it still shows your real address: anyone can strip the “+site” part. A real alias from a service you choose is better: paste it above. Klin runs no alias service.

ar_not1.message: **It does not create permanent aliases.** It remembers the ones you made with a service you choose. Disposable addresses come from mail.tm.

ar_not2.message: ==It is kept on this device only==, in your Klin profile, not encrypted. Anyone who can open your profile can read it. Nothing is sent anywhere, and there is no sync.

ar_not3.message: **It cannot prove who leaked an address.** It tells you who you gave it to. A site can also be breached.

ar_not4.message: The password of a disposable address stays in this browser only and is not in a backup file: after loading a backup its inbox cannot be opened.

ar_not5.message: A backup is a plain file. Keep it where you keep your private files.

ar_err_email.message: That does not look like an email address.

ar_err_site.message: Write the site it was given to.

ar_err_backup.message: That file is not a Klin alias backup.

ar_plus_err.message: Write your address above, and the site in the form.

ar_who_none.message: That address is not in your list.

ar_backup_saved.message: Backup saved as klin-aliases.json. It is a plain file.

ar_backup_loaded.message: Added {1}, skipped {2} (already there or not valid).

ar_d_needsite.message: Write the site this address is for, in the form above, first.

ar_d_noperm.message: Without your permission to contact the service nothing was sent.

ar_d_created.message: Created {1} and saved it in your list.
